title: How digital breakdowns affect supply chains — and endanger the global economy
title_zh: 数字化失效如何影响供应链并危及全球经济
abstract: When supply chains fail, it’s often because of energy, computer or data-network failures. Addressing these requires a way to make interdependencies visible.
abstract_zh: 当供应链失效时，往往是由于能源、计算机或数据网络故障。解决这些问题需要一种方法，使相互依赖关系可视化。
